stem: Nightingale Health's cloud team has been told spend on cross-boundary network traffic has grown for three months straight, but nobody can say which resource, path, or Region is driving it.

choices.text: Increase the size of every EC2 instance behind the flagged egress path
Move every workload behind CloudFront regardless of content type
Purchase a Compute Savings Plan sized to current EC2 usage
Enable VPC Flow Logs and review CloudWatch and Cost Explorer data by usage type

rationale: VPC Flow Logs plus CloudWatch and Cost Explorer broken down by usage type is how you identify which resource, path, or Region is actually driving the growing charge before changing anything. Resizing instances adds compute cost without identifying or addressing the driver. Moving every workload behind CloudFront skips finding the cause and does not help traffic that is not cacheable. A compute commitment discount addresses EC2 pricing, not the cause of network transfer cost.
